Before you apply

A few helpful answers.

For financing costs and terms, contact GreenSky at 866-936-0602 or service@greensky.com.

Who provides the loan?

Loans are made by financial institutions participating in the GreenSky consumer loan program. GreenSky and GreenSky Servicing are not lenders. Credit decisions and loan terms are determined by program lenders.

Is the 12-month promotion interest-free?

Plan 2521 has deferred interest. Interest is billed during the promotion and is waived only if the amount financed is paid in full before the promotional period ends. No payments are required during those 12 months, but leaving an unpaid balance means the interest will not be waived.

When will my first payment be due?

Payment timing depends on the plan you select. Refer to your loan agreement for the specific due dates and repayment terms.

How do I authorize a contractor payment?

When your contractor requests a payment, you receive a text message or email to authorize the transaction. Review the transaction before authorizing it.

Where do I make loan payments?

Payments can be made through the GreenSky customer portal (opens in a new tab), by phone, or through automatic bank payments. Consult your agreement for details.

Financing disclosures

All financing is subject to credit approval. Rates and terms are valid as of the print date of the supplied flyer, November 2, 2026, and are subject to change. Payment examples are estimates only. Actual payment amounts are based on the amount and timing of purchases. Call 866-936-0602 for financing costs and terms.

Loans for the GreenSky® consumer loan program are offered and made by federally insured, federal or state chartered financial institutions providing credit without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, gender, disability, or familial status. A list of financial institutions currently providing loans through the GreenSky® Program is available at GreenSky bank partners.

GreenSky Servicing, LLC services the loans on behalf of your lender, NMLS #1416362. NMLS Consumer Access. GreenSky® is a registered trademark of GreenSky, LLC and is licensed to banks and other financial institutions for their use in connection with that consumer loan program. GreenSky Servicing, LLC is a financial technology company that manages the GreenSky® consumer loan program by providing origination and servicing support to banks and other financial institutions that make or hold program loans. GreenSky, LLC and GreenSky Servicing, LLC are not lenders. All credit decisions and loan terms are determined by program lenders.
